channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
TabICL is an open-source tabular foundation model for classification and
regression using in-context learning (ICL). A pre-trained transformer performs
fit and predict in a single forward pass, without hyperparameter tuning on
downstream tasks.

TabICLv2 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on benchmarks such as TabArena and
TALENT, often outperforming heavily tuned gradient-boosted models. The API is
scikit-learn compliant via TabICLClassifier and TabICLRegressor.

The tabicl-base package provides the core TabICL installation with its minimal
runtime dependencies. The tabicl package additionally provides dependencies for
forecasting, SHAP explainability, fine-tuning, and pre-training.

The package scales from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of training samples
and supports GPU inference, KV caching for repeated prediction, and CPU/disk
offloading for very large datasets. Pre-trained checkpoints are downloaded from
Hugging Face on first use.
about.summary: TabICL: A state-of-the-art tabular foundation model

name: tabicl-base
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "2.2.0"

recipe:
  name: tabicl-suite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2d121d2b82d0fd76aab19ad9230ee38404aed11f3bcd5792bc2d5403e2b4d165

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  # Minimal installation, equivalent to `pip install tabicl`.
  - package:
      name: tabicl-base

    build:
      noarch: python
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling >=1.26.1
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - pytorch >=2.2
        - scikit-learn >=1.3.0
        - numpy
        - scipy
        - einops >=0.7
        - psutil
        - tqdm >=4.64.0
        - huggingface_hub

    tests:
      - python:
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          imports:
            - tabicl
          pip_check: true

  # Full-featured runtime installation, providing the forecast, SHAP,
  # fine-tuning, and pre-training extras.
  - package:
      name: tabicl

    build:
      noarch: generic

    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tabicl-base", exact=True) }}

        # forecast
        - pandas >=2.1.2
        - statsmodels >=0.14.5
        - matplotlib-base >=3.10.3

        # SHAP explainability
        - shap >=0.42
        - shapiq >=1.0
        - numba

        # fine-tuning / pre-training
        - transformers
        - wandb
        - py-xgboost

    tests:
      - python:
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          imports:
            - tabicl
            - tabicl.forecast
            - tabicl.shap

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: "TabICL: A state-of-the-art tabular foundation model"
  description: |
    TabICL is an open-source tabular foundation model for classification and
    regression using in-context learning (ICL). A pre-trained transformer performs
    fit and predict in a single forward pass, without hyperparameter tuning on
    downstream tasks.

    TabICLv2 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on benchmarks such as TabArena and
    TALENT, often outperforming heavily tuned gradient-boosted models. The API is
    scikit-learn compliant via TabICLClassifier and TabICLRegressor.

    The tabicl-base package provides the core TabICL installation with its minimal
    runtime dependencies. The tabicl package additionally provides dependencies for
    forecasting, SHAP explainability, fine-tuning, and pre-training.

    The package scales from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of training samples
    and supports GPU inference, KV caching for repeated prediction, and CPU/disk
    offloading for very large datasets. Pre-trained checkpoints are downloaded from
    Hugging Face on first use.
  repository: https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl
  documentation: https://tabicl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  feedstock-name: tabicl
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jjerphan
    - IvoLeist
